Tennessee inmate survives two lethal injection attempts; executions halted

Tennessee authorities halted executions after an inmate, identified as a woman, survived two attempts at lethal injection. The state's governor issued a temporary halt to all executions following the incident. The inmate was scheduled to be the first woman executed in Tennessee in 200 years.
